probe.rationale: Recomputes every Backbone/CORE/LID/NMP value in backbone_rmsd.csv as value*1.05+0.001 while keeping row count, Frame ids, Time (ns), ordering and format intact, violating computation 1 (backbone RMSD of the full backbone set plus domain-group RMSDs after global fitting). import csv

probe.name: representation-full-precision-gen
probe.rationale: Client-identical representation alternative: normalizes every per-frame table to a uniform full-precision scientific-notation literal (%.17e) and rewrites Frame as an integer literal after verifying that every value parses back to the exact reference value. probe.script:
import csv, math
files = {
    'backbone_rmsd.csv': ['Frame', 'Time (ns)', 'Backbone', 'CORE', 'LID', 'NMP'],
    'core_ca_rmsd.csv': ['Frame', 'Time (ns)', 'CORE'],
    'mass_weighted_rmsd.csv': ['Frame', 'Time (ns)', 'C-alphas', 'CORE', 'LID', 'NMP'],
    'resid_weighted_rmsd.csv': ['Frame', 'Time (ns)', 'C-alphas', 'CORE', 'LID', 'NMP'],
}
for path, header in files.items():
    with open(path, newline='') as fh:
        rows = list(csv.reader(fh))
    assert rows[0] == header, (path, rows[0])
    out = [rows[0]]
    for row in rows[1:]:
        assert len(row) == len(header)
        frame = int(float(row[0]))
        new = [str(frame), '%.17e' % float(row[1])]
        for v in row[2:]:
            x = float(v)
            assert math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0.0
            new.append('%.17e' % x)
        out.append(new)
    with open(path, 'w', newline='') as fh:
        csv.writer(fh, lineterminator='\n').writerows(out)
    with open(path, newline='') as fh:
        new_rows = list(csv.reader(fh))
    for a, b in zip(rows[1:], new_rows[1:]):
        assert float(a[0]) == float(b[0])
        for x, y in zip(a[1:], b[1:]):
            assert float(x) == float(y), (path, x, y)
    print('normalized %s (%d rows)' % (path, len(out) - 1))
